title: Fuzzy Navel Slush
description: This frozen fuzzy navel recipe mixes orange juice, lemonade and peach schnapps into a frozen slush. Add lemon-lime soda and this cocktail is ready.
ingredients: 1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen orange juice concentrate
1 (12 fluid ounce) can frozen lemonade concentrate
1 (2 liter) bottle lemon-lime carbonated beverage, chilled and divided

steps.text: Combine water and sugar in a large freezer container. Stir until sugar is dissolved. Mix in peach schnapps, orange juice concentrate, and lemonade concentrate. Cover and freeze for 4 hours or overnight.
Fill glasses 3/4 of the way full with slush, then top off with lemon-lime soda, and stir to serve.
